name: The True Masters
label: Quest
description: The True Masters: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I am going to empower you as an acting deputy of Stormwind, friend.
Return to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire and deliver this decree.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It could have been worse, I suppose...
It appears as if the fate of Lakeshire rests squarely on your shoulders.
You notice Magistrate Solomon blinking rapidly. He appears to be crying.
